answer_1.quote: We propose a semiparametric tokensequence co-supervision training method, which trains a single autoregressive language model ... The generated response is in the same form as the training instances ... Experiments over 10 information-seeking datasets show that such co-supervision consistently outperforms models trained with each supervision separately.
answer_1.outputs: generated long-form answers/responses to information‑seeking queries

answer_2.quote: We measure model performance via three metrics. Correctness and grounding performance measures the generation ability of the model and how well it utilizes knowledge from the external sequence. Retrieval performance mainly measures how well the model finds relevant sequences.

answer_3.quote: We use TRUE, a T5-11B model finetuned on various NLI datasets, to see whether the external knowledge entails a part of the response that is generated based on the knowledge.
